segments.name: blank check company
segments.description: Blank check shell company with no operations, seeking a business combination, focused on the global space economy.
segments.evidence: We are a blank check company incorporated on September 12, 2025 as a Cayman Islands exempted company for the purpose of effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses (the "Business Combination").
